text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "The Nuclear Safety Commission", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "The NSC advises the Federal Council, the Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications (DETEC) and the Federal Nuclear Safety Inspectorate (FNSI)", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The Nuclear Safety Commission\nThe NSC advises the Federal Council,"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Eidgenössische Kommission für nukleare Sicherheit KNS", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Departement UVEK", "severity": 0.2, "before": "den Bundesrat,"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Eidgenössisches Nuklearsicherheitsinspektorat ENSI", "severity": 0.2, "before": "das Eidgenössische Nuklearsicherheitsinspektorat ENSI"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Verordnung über die Eidgenössische Kommission für nukleare Sicherheit (VKNS, SR 732.16)", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Verordnung über die Nuclear Safety Commission (NSC Ordinance, SR 732.16)"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Sie besteht aus fünf bis sieben nebenamtlichen Mitgliedern, die Sachkundige auf Gebieten der Wissenschaft und Technik sind, die für die nukleare Sicherheit wichtig sind.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The NSC is a permanent administrative commission, which comprises five to seven part-time members who are specialists in areas of science and technology that are of importance to nuclear safety."}]}
